name: Admiral Kino
notes: small arthouse cinema; wp-admin-ajax action=get_ajax_posts returns the whole known programme (not paginated by date, currentDate filtering happens client-side); currently in Sommerpause (closed 3.-20. Aug), those 13 closure-placeholder rows are skipped; price never published so price_min is always null; image is each detail page's og:image, fetched concurrently (ThreadPoolExecutor, 8 workers, 3 retries) - the sandbox network here was flaky (intermittent 'no route to host'), the retries are load-bearing; duration comes straight off the ajax feed's own 'duration' field ('NNN Minuten') as extra.duration_min, no detail fetch needed for that - one non-film photography-exhibition item published an implausible '1524 Minuten' verbatim, kept as-is since it's the site's own data, not fabricated
